## CredentialsModule.createOutOfBandOffer() method

Initiate a new credential exchange as issuer by creating a credential offer not bound to any connection. The offer must be delivered out-of-band to the holder

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
createOutOfBandOffer(credentialTemplate: CredentialOfferTemplate): Promise<{
        offerMessage: OfferCredentialMessage;
        credentialRecord: CredentialRecord;
    }>;
```
